gates: edition only level 2 - correct edition not secured

edition.check: Level 5: 'The INPUT contains a barcode...' -> NOT MET: Input does not contain a barcode. Level 4: 'without barcode: title, artist, format and at least one further attribute unambiguous in >= 2 sources, and no other edition fitting the input has a different tracklist' -> NOT MET: The input provides only title, artist, and format without any further attributes, and competing editions fitting the input have different tracklists (e.g. 2023 3×LP edition with 22 tracks, MB release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f). Level 3: 'several editions fit but ALL share the same tracklist: the choice does not matter' -> NOT MET: Not all fitting vinyl releases share the same tracklist. Level 2: 'Several editions fit the input and at least one of them has a DIFFERENT tracklist; the choice rests on weak signals' -> MET: The input fits the standard 13-track 2×LP as well as the 22-track 3×LP 10th Anniversary edition; selecting the original standard edition rests on the weak signal that no edition qualifier was specified.
edition.summary: Multiple vinyl editions of the album exist with differing track counts (13 tracks vs. 22 tracks), and the bare input does not rule out the expanded edition.

tracklist.check: Level 5: '>= 2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles (spelling variants only)' -> MET: MusicBrainz (release/4867ceba-ffe7-40c0-a093-45be6c03c655) and Discogs (release/4570366) both list exactly 13 tracks across sides A1–D4 in identical order, with only standard capitalization and punctuation differences.
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz and Discogs fully agree on track count, positions (A1–D4), and titles for the chosen 2×LP edition.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: 'Database + independent primary source of the same edition' -> NOT MET: Both sources are secondary databases; no direct primary source was inspected. Level 4: 'Two independent database entries (recognisable by differing details)' -> MET: MusicBrainz and Discogs provide independent entries with distinct metadata (e.g. precise millisecond track lengths on MusicBrainz vs. detailed runout etchings on Discogs).
sources.summary: The research is supported by two established, independent databases (MusicBrainz and Discogs).

concerns: The input lacks a barcode, catalog number, or release year, meaning it does not explicitly rule out competing vinyl releases with different tracklists, such as the 2023 10th Anniversary 3×LP edition (22 tracks).

validation_errors: artists is empty: list every distinct artist on the carrier (main, featured, remixer), each once
